name: MCB 3846W
title: Molecular Evolution of Infectious Diseases
description: Discussion of the scientific literature leveraging genetic technologies to rapidly identify, characterize, monitor, and evaluate evolutionary patterns and behavioral mechanisms of contemporary and ancient pathogens in humans.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007, 1010, or 1011; MCB 2400; Not open for credit to students who have passed MCB 3841W when taught as “Molecular Evolution of Infectious Diseases" Recommended preparation: EEB 2245.
